description: The semantic twin of the perf/cases big-* performance cases (II-15 §25): open a table-type recordset on Big (2048 rows, ID Long primary key, V Text(120)) with no Index set, hold Fields, Field ID and Field V, then until EOF read ID.Value and V.Value and MoveNext (at most 2100 rows); close. Asks the exact typed value of every field of every row in storage order, which the timed bodies consume only as a checksum. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
